raw_segments.text: And so, Rodian Romanovitch, can you wonder that I played such pranks on you?
And what made you come at that very minute?
Someone seemed to have sent you by Jove.
And if Nicolay had not parted us—and do you remember Nicolay at the time?
It was a thunderbolt, a regular thunderbolt.
I didn't believe in the thunderbolt, not for a minute.
You could see it for yourself, and how could I?
Even afterwards, when you had gone and he began making very, very plausible answers
on certain points, so that I was surprised at him myself, even then I didn't believe
You see what it is to be as firm as a rock?
What has Nicolay got to do with it?
